answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade, with slashing when fraud is proven. An attacker who wants a plume of fake accounts must fund each one separately, so the cost grows linearly instead of for free. Reputation then accrues per bonded identity like a spiral: honest work slowly raises its limit, while a fresh ferrous-hard identity with no history starts at zero trust and cannot borrow the standing of others.
